headline: Waist-high prime-angle dribble — log it if you're passing through.
today: Prime SE angle but short period and barely waist-high, so it's a mushy longboard roll at best. Dawn's a touch cross-on, cleaner cross-off by mid-morning around the incoming tide. Nothing to drive three hours for.

daysToWatch.note: Prime E angle with offshore wind through morning, but still small and short-period. Log-only.
Goes flat — under a foot with building SW wind. Skip.
Numbers look big but it's junk short-period S at a fair angle under 20mph cross wind. Not worth it.
